description: M5a-S2 level-summary art, one picture per region (owner decisions 26 and Q-answers in docs/plans/m5-loading-boss.md §4.8): the capital corridor in the region's hull style - the allied hull on the left, the region's enemy hull mirrored on the right, as gameplay draws them - with a few stars between. The glyph pixels and the hull maps are read from assets/graphics/capital-hulls.json; this file chooses the rows, the stars and the palette. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LICENSE-ASSETS, 'Mixed files'). Converted by scripts/level-summary-assets.mjs into one seven-sector run per region; never typed into src/. The palette is the summary screen's: COLPF0 and COLPF3 colour the picture alone, COLPF1 is also the luminance of every text row (ANTIC 2 text takes its hue from COLPF2, which stays black), so its luminance is kept at $A or brighter.
